data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter client for OpenAI REST APIs and realtime WebSocket/WebRTC workflows.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe access to OpenAI APIs including GPT, image and audio generation, embeddings, and realtime workflows. Supports Dart and Flutter across mobile, desktop, web, and servers.
use_when: You need to integrate OpenAI text generation, tool calling, or structured outputs in a Dart or Flutter app.
You want real-time audio or WebSocket workflows connected to OpenAI models.
avoid_when: You require on-device local models without external API calls.
You are using the deprecated Assistants API which shut down on August 26, 2026.
strengths: Comprehensive API coverage including Responses API, images, audio, agents, and realtime sessions.
Works in both pure Dart backends and Flutter apps without Flutter-specific dependencies.
weaknesses: Requires managing API keys and keeping sensitive keys secure on trusted infrastructure rather than client-side apps.
Relies entirely on remote network calls and third-party service availability.
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.12 or later and an OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable or explicit configuration.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose llamadart if you need to run local language models rather than communicating with the remote OpenAI REST API.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose firebase_ai if your infrastructure uses Google's Firebase AI services instead of OpenAI.
